headline: What the Government is asking for in the amendment to the 2026 budget
summary: The government asked Congress to lift the 2026 fiscal deficit from 3.24% to 4.2% of GDP and suspend the 2024 fiscal responsibility rule until December 31. The request is part of a budget amendment.
why: Fiscal deficit targets and fiscal rules signal how much a government will borrow, which affects sovereign debt yields and the country's credit profile.
original_headline: Lo que pide el Gobierno en modificación al presupuesto 2026
